name: MOW_ASSESS_TEMPLATES_B
description: An assessment template comprises of set of weighted questions and responses, which measures the health of a business object during the assessment process.

columns.name: ASSESS_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Primary key column for this table.  Stores unique ids for templates.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: ASSESS_TEMPLATE_NUMBER
columns.description: Alternate Key

columns.name: ASSESSED_OBJ_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Column to reference business object type for this particular template.  Example, OPTY, CONTACT.  The type code is stored in ZMM_OBJECTS table.

columns.name: RELATED_OBJ_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Column to store related business object type for this particular template.  Example, CONTACT.  The related type code is stored in ZMM_OBJECTS table.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Stores Status of template.  Valid values seeded in FND_LOOKUPS.  Values include: IN_PROGRESS, ACTIVE, INACTIVE, RETIRED.

columns.name: SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies a set of reference data shared across business units and other entities. Also known as Reference Data Sets, they are used to filter reference data in transactional UIs.

columns.name: ADMIN_BU_ID
columns.description: Captures BU_ID of the admin who created the assessment template.

columns.name: FREEFORM_TEXT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if freeform response values are allowed in assessment that uses this template.  Value of null or Y indicates that freeform responses are allowed in runtime assessment.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Column to support soft delete.

columns.name: COLOR_GRAPH_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if  status gauge in runtime assessment to be displayed in color.

columns.name: PUBLIC_FLAG
columns.description: Siebel column lift and shifted.  No functional use in V1.

columns.name: AUTO_TRIGGER_FLAG
columns.description: Siebel column lift and shifted.  No functional use in V1.

columns.name: SCORE_RANGE_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if score range values are manually over written in template.  Value of null or N indicates that score range values are auto generated based on ratings assigned to responses.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.
